notes.title: May 13th, 2020 Update - Added Keyconfig
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, hope you're all doing well!

Just a quick update to let you guys know that we've added a new keyconfig menu to Disaster Report 4: Summer Memories. This menu can be accessed from both the title menu and the in-game menu, and you're able to change both keyboard and gamepad bindings.

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to us either on here or on Discord at discord.gg/nisa

Best,
Daniel

notes.title: May 7th, 2020 Update - VR for Steam
notes.notes:
Heyo!



We've now added VR support for Disaster Report 4: Summer Memories on Steam! 
To play in VR mode, you need to download the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289740]VR Mode DLC[/url], and you need to have completed the level you want to play in VR, in the main game.

For example, if you want to play through the Downtown Area in VR mode, you'll have to complete it in the main game first.

List of known supported VR Headsets:
[list]
[*]Samsung Odyssey+
[*]HTC Vive/Vive Pro
[*]Oculus Rift/Rift S
[/list]
[i]This list only includes headsets that we've tested and verified work. If your VR headset works and is not on this list, feel free to let us know and we'll add it to the list.[/i]



Hope you're all doing well and staying safe!
-Daniel

notes.title: Disaster Report 4: Summer Memories gets an April release date
notes.notes:
There are a lot of experiences video games allow you to participate in that are fun in a video game, but definitely would not be fun in real life. Disaster Report 4: Summer Memories, a game in which you’re dropped into a city being wracked by the aftermath of an earthquake, is one of them. But, if you’re reading this and thinking this is something you want to experience in video game form, then fear not, because it’s being released this April.
